integrity: Exact algebraic proof, verified boundary examples, and reproducible exact-integer finite test are supplied. No external or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unconditional only for positive integers with power-of-two Euler totient; no classification of other inputs or of the unrestricted fixed-point equation. The finite computation is corroborative, not a substitute for proof.
title: Constructible-index solutions of the totient-derivative equation
